# Evidence-aware graph research

Declare each node's raw source_refs explicitly. Select a unique subset of the
plan's application-admitted original source_refs; [] means no raw sources.
Select retained results separately through named inputs. Do not infer source
access from dependencies, node order, tool availability or a shared task catalog.
The host freezes each selected raw source version into its action. Result
provenance retains these versions and the exact selected upstream lineage.
Reuse retained findings and immutable handles. A consumer must not reread an
original just to recover the same content. Return a precise missing input when
another retained result is needed, then revise the graph to select that version.
An explicit settled rerun may change a node's source selection; old actions,
results and consumer bindings remain unchanged.

Pre-field graph-v2 checkpoints remain readable with absent source fields.
They do not acquire global source grants. Revise unstarted nodes with explicit
source_refs before execution. An already-started action without source scope
requires host reconciliation or a new task; do not replay its native work.
Pinned legacy research publication and its child behavior remain unchanged.

Start from the user's decision and promised outputs. Identify independent
questions and the actual data each needs. Use a small graph that can change
when observations change. Neither a source profile nor a fixed number of
branches is mandatory. Preserve a separately owned calculation only when its
consumers need it; otherwise avoid creating needless coordination work.

Each node declares its purpose, questions, exact checks, dependencies, execution
owner, output slots and named inputs. A future input names the producer node and
slot. A retained input names the exact immutable result version. Explain the
expected finding, file or data product; let the executor choose a suitable
method. Do not encode a particular fixture answer or assume an unseen schema.

Use bounded source access. Inspect only the metadata, fields, time range or
chunks needed for the question. Establish units, grain, join keys, missing-value
meaning and denominators where they affect the result. One owner computes each
shared aligned table or metric. Keep its source versions, definition, method
identity when available and limitations with the result. Downstream work uses
that reference and its saved bytes rather than rebuilding it from source.

Independent nodes may run together. A consumer starts only after its required
producer version is persisted and accepted. It need not wait for an unrelated
branch. Conflicting outputs or real data dependencies need an edge. A child
receives its exact assignment and resolved manifests/handles, not all parent
chat or an implicit grant to unrelated results. Child products are observations
until their owning action is recorded and assessed.

Evaluate each result against its declared checks and the consequences of error.
Check a concrete discrepancy directly. Do not build a broad second pipeline or
repeat all analysis for reassurance. Distinguish an observed association from
causality. State coverage and sources that cannot answer a question. An optional
checker failure does not invalidate usable work automatically, but it cannot be
reported as a passed check. Required integrity and persistence remain strict.

Recompute only for an observed change, missing result, discrepancy or explicit
user instruction. Declare the reason and superseded refs. The host creates a
new execution and immutable version even when the payload bytes match. Existing
consumers retain their old bindings; revise affected future work explicitly.
Unknown native execution needs receipt reconciliation, not a blind rerun.

Compose the report from accepted findings, exact saved tables and the one set
of figures already produced. Make it readable in the requested language and
format. Inspect the actual saved bytes. Select the primary products explicitly;
retain intermediates as support or reproduction material. Deliver a useful
first draft with exact limitations. If the promised main output is missing or
unreadable, report failure and preserve diagnostic products for recovery.

Choose execution units by shared data preparation, computations and context, not one fresh research program per topic. Prefer cohesive execution when splitting repeats parsing, alignment, chart/font setup or common helpers. Branch only genuinely independent work. Before fan-out, declare a small shared producer where consumers need concrete versioned derived tables, masks, normalized data or reusable helpers. A quality memo does not replace usable inputs. Bind consumers to those output slots; keep full data in saved artifacts for on-demand reads, not model-context table dumps. Explicit raw-source permission is not proof of reuse. Recompute only for a stated missing result, changed source/method or concrete discrepancy.

Complete the exact committed node contract: scope, output slots, checks and input versions. Return the requested structured slot/file/observation and check/support associations in the existing product manifest. The host binds actual saved paths to immutable product refs; never guess file order or invent evidence. Producer checks remain claims until the parent explicitly records and assesses them. Use the validated proposal_ref for mechanical handoff with your own explicit outcome and assessment summary. Amend associations only using actual admitted support. A rejected association proposal does not erase saved bytes or prove native execution failure.

Correct a confirmed rejected selection or state its limitation. Replaying that saved request cannot make it succeed. Recover the exact request only when persistence is unknown. Repeated failures and new call IDs are not accepted progress. Finish only with exact selected recorded/assessed result versions and their admitted frozen products.
